title: Two countries, one heroine! Sofia POLCANOVA
body_html:
Moldova has shown the whole world that it is a source of sporting talent, and Sofia Polcanova is one of the most striking examples of the excellence of the home table tennis school. As a reminder, Sofia achieved an unprecedented feat for Austria, winning 3 gold, 5 silver and 2 bronze medals at the European Table Tennis Championships. She made history for that country and became a national heroine of Austrian table tennis.

But beyond her glorious performances on the world stage — ranked in the world TOP 15 and a multiple European champion — Sofia Polcanova is also a heroine of the Republic of Moldova: as an honorary member of ATTP, she remains actively involved in our country’s sporting life.

Having founded and supported the TOP CUP table tennis association in Chișinău for the third year running, Sofia guides the organisation of the most popular and grandest table tennis tournaments in the history of the Republic of Moldova. These magnificent tournaments, held under the auspices of ATTP and on an exceptional scale, bring together hundreds of good and honest table tennis amateurs every time.

On New Year’s Eve, the famous Sofia Polcanova honoured us with a visit to TOP CUP Academy, where young fans, professional players and coaches had been eagerly awaiting her. There, in an interview for WeSport, Sofia shared her emotions and some special moments from her sporting life.

On the same occasion, ATTP President Rostislav SOBIEȚKI presented the champion and honorary ATTP member Sofia POLCANOVA with a (gold) diploma of excellence for her substantial contribution to the development of table tennis in the Republic of Moldova.
